t_advice_summary_textbox.text: some colours gave better points but it changed after the break so you have to pay attention to which one is better

vb_textbox.text: i found that certain colours performed better. at the beginning, experiment between the colours and try to keep track of which colours are better for you. i think sometimes this changed half way through each round, so if you find that a gnome who had been getting you lots of mushrooms suddenly starts performing badly, try switching to the other one. its worth noting this happens after the breaks as well, so try to take the breaks to refresh your brain and prepare for remembering a new selection of colours. good luck!
